answer: One workable design: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because copper only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, sable is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any tundra approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
